item.title: Richmond Chocolate, Wine & Whiskey Festival draws crowds despite bitter cold temperatures
item.description: The 4th Annual Richmond Chocolate, Wine & Whiskey Festival featured 100+ local vendors offering boozy treats and tastings despite cold weather.

item.title: Lowe's helps Virginia animal shelter with hay donation during Arctic blast
item.description: The Lowe's in Prince George donated 50 hay bales to help an animal shelter keep pets warm during the bitter cold weather.

item.title: PokeKon Fest brings Pokemon fans together in RVA for epic convention
item.description: PokeKon Fest drew hundreds of Pokemon fans to Richmond for a one-day convention featuring voice actors, cosplay and vintage collectibles.
